name: Agile
effect: The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon -4 per attack instead of -5. The penalty on opportunity attacks is 1 less

name: Aiming Focus
effect: When casting spells with a range over 10 tiles, their range increases by 4.

name: Bayonet
effect: Bayonets are fastened on runegun rifles, and provide an quick melee attack. Their construction means you have -1 penalty on attacks with them

name: Block (X)
effect: While holding this weapon you have the Block action.
specialAction: 1 Action. Get ready to block incoming attacks and spells. You have a +X bonus to your Reflex and Fortitude saves against targeted attacks and non-environmental area effects until the start of next turn.

name: Channeling
effect: You can still perform somantic component with a hand holding a channeling weapon.

name: Deadly (dX)
effect: Critical hits with this weapon adds the specified dice to the damage.

name: Disarm
effect: You make the Disarm Maneuver with this weapon, using its range and the attack bonus you have with it

name: Extend (X)
effect: You can extend this weapon to the range specified as part of the strike. While extended you have a -2 move speed penalty and cannot make reactive strikes until you take an action to retract it

name: Finesse
effect: You can use your DEX instead of PHY when making attacks with this weapon. PHY is still added to the damage roll (even if its negative)

name: Heavy
effect: Small or tiny creatures have disadvantage on attacks with this weapon.

name: Light
effect: You may attempt to hide a light weapon on you as a Slight of Hand action.

name: Loud
effect: Using this weapon creates a loud burst of noise

name: Parry
effect: While holding this weapon you have the Parry action.
specialAction: 1 Action. Get ready to parry. When you are attacked by a melee attack until the start of next turn you may defend with your weapon attack bonus instead of your Reflex save.

name: Precision
effect: When targeting weak points the penalty is 2 lower than normal (to a minimum of 1).

name: Propulsive
effect: You add your PHY bonus to the damage rolls of this weapon

name: Ranged
effect: You use your DEX instead of PHY when making attacks with this weapon. No bonus is added to the damage of the weapon (unless it has propulsive)

name: Ranged Trip
effect: Foes hit by this weapon must make a Fortitude saving throw or fall prone

name: Shove
effect: Creatures hit by this weapon need to make a Fortitude saving throw or be moved up to 1 tile of attackers choice.

name: Slowing (X)
effect: Your move speed is reduced by X tiles when holding this.

name: Sluggish
effect: The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon -6 per attack instead of -5. The penalty on opportunity attacks is 1 more

name: Sweep
effect: The multiple attack penalty you take with this weapon is -3 if the last attack was against a different target

name: Swing Around
effect: You also ignore half the bonus from cover and the Block ability

name: Thrown (X)
effect: You can throw this weapon up to specified range as a ranged attack.

name: Unwieldy
effect: While attacking with this weapon you have a -3 penalty if the target is adjacent to you

name: Versatile
effect: You choose the damage type among those specified. If the damage type has a dice next to it changes the damage roll to that.

name: Volley
effect: While attacking with this weapon you have a -3 penalty if the target is within Volley Range

name: Grab
effect: If your next action after hitting a creature with this attack is a Grapple Maneuver, it neither counts nor applies multi attack penalties.

name: Improved Grab
effect: If your next action after hitting a creature with this attack is a Grapple Maneuver, it costs no action and neither counts nor applies multi attack penalties.

name: Innate
effect: You use your WIL instead of PHY when making attacks and damage rolls with this weapon

name: Psionic
effect: You use your INT instead of PHY when making attacks and damage rolls with this weapon
